primary_endpoint: SAF Activity Score decrease of at least 2 points with no worsening of CRN fibrosis score at 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: The results list participant values of 41, 34, and 22, followed by 42, 49, and 59; reported p-values were 0.061 and 0.004 (Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel).
safety_signal: Serious AEs: IVA337 1200 mg, 7/83; IVA337 800 mg, 3/83; placebo, 3/81. No deaths.
